summary: Most frontend changes align with moving to Internet Identity-only auth and principal-based role checks, plus an admin Settings UI for listing users and changing roles. However, the backend migration/state handling shown does not demonstrate upgrade-safe persistence for the new principal->role provisioning data, and there are several unrelated feature additions (per summaries) not requested by the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add upgrade-safe migration logic for any new stable principal->role (user/role) storage so existing canister data is preserved across upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: The added migration module only migrates `{ nextCategoryId : Nat }` and does not show migration/preservation of any new role/user state. Additionally, the new provisioning tracker `provisionedUsers` is introduced as an in-memory `Map` in `backend/main.mo` without any shown stable persistence/migration handling, so upgrade safety for principal->role provisioning is not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a new backend module file `backend/migration.mo` rather than keeping all backend logic in a single Motoko actor file as constrained.
hallucinated_features.reason: Constraint states backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services/modules). The diff adds `backend/migration.mo`.

hallucinated_features.description: Kept/introduced a dedicated `CredentialLoginPage` that now displays an informational message about auth flow changes.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest required removing the credential-login gate; it did not request a replacement informational credential login page/component.

hallucinated_features.description: Unrelated large-scale feature work (COGS tabs/trends, reports rework with date-range selectors, KPI/net-profit calculation changes, master data/payment method UI behavior, print CSS/theme changes, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: These items are not part of REQ-1..REQ-6 and appear as additional enhancements beyond the requested Internet Identity role-based access and admin user management.
Not requested; appears to be an artifact rather than part of the specified feature set.
